sections.title: The Vending Machine Incident
sections.intent: Establish Arlo's mundane life and his transition to the game world via a comedic death.
sections.end_condition: Arlo dies and begins the reincarnation process into Aethelgard Online.

sections.title: The Character Sheet Disaster
sections.intent: Introduce the game mechanics and Arlo's devastatingly low Luck stat.
sections.end_condition: Arlo confirms his -999 Luck has triggered an 'Overflow' status on his character sheet.

sections.title: The Slime Sprint
sections.intent: Demonstrate the 'Crit Hit & Run' exploit through a low-stakes combat encounter.
sections.end_condition: Arlo successfully kills a slime while running away, realizing his retreat-based attacks are guaranteed criticals.

sections.title: Grinding the Coward's Way
sections.intent: Show Arlo refining his 'retreat-strike' technique on tutorial mobs to gather basic gear.
sections.end_condition: Arlo reaches the Tutorial Guardian's gate equipped with basic gear and a plan.

sections.title: The Guardian's Arena
sections.intent: A high-intensity battle where Arlo must use his exploit to defeat a boss designed to be impossible for solo players.
sections.end_condition: The Tutorial Guardian is defeated by a final, retreating blow.

sections.title: Loot and Logistics
sections.intent: Arlo claims the massive loot drop and upgrades his mobility to better facilitate his combat style.
sections.end_condition: Arlo purchases the 'Dash' skill book and prepares to enter the main hub city.

sections.title: The Hub City Hustle
sections.intent: Arlo enters Oakhaven and attempts to liquidate his high-tier tutorial loot without raising suspicion.
sections.end_condition: Arlo's attempt to sell rare items attracts the attention of the 'Min-Maxers' guild.

sections.title: Interrogation by the Elite
sections.intent: The guild leaders confront Arlo, suspecting him of using third-party hacking software.
sections.end_condition: The guild leader, Vex, corners Arlo and demands a live demonstration of his 'skills'.

sections.title: The Ultimatum
sections.intent: Arlo negotiates his survival by accepting a challenge that forces him to reveal his exploit.
sections.end_condition: Arlo agrees to the 'Trial of the Coward' to prove his innocence and gain guild protection.

sections.title: The Dungeon Entrance
sections.intent: Set the scene for the dungeon trial and introduce Jax, the guild's skeptical scout.
sections.end_condition: Arlo and Jax enter the Sunken Crypts to begin the no-frontal-damage challenge.

sections.title: The Reverse Gauntlet
sections.intent: Arlo clears the dungeon using his 'Yellow Streak' style, confusing and impressing Jax.
sections.end_condition: The final room of the crypt is cleared without Arlo ever facing an enemy head-on.

sections.title: The Glitch Discovery
sections.intent: The duo finds an anomaly in the dungeon that leads to a hidden, unstable zone.
sections.end_condition: Arlo identifies the entrance to the 'System Glitch' zone at the back of the boss room.

sections.title: The Red Text Warning
sections.intent: The System announces a patch to fix exploits, putting Arlo's existence at risk.
sections.end_condition: The emergency maintenance countdown begins, giving Arlo one hour to reach the Source Code altar.

sections.title: The High-Level Shortcut
sections.intent: Arlo and Jax must navigate a dangerous high-level map to reach the altar before the server reset.
sections.end_condition: They successfully cross the Deadlands, narrowly avoiding lethal high-level mobs.

sections.title: The Glitch Zone Threshold
sections.intent: They arrive at the heart of the glitch zone where the laws of the game are breaking down.
sections.end_condition: Arlo and Jax reach the entrance of the Source Code chamber as the countdown hits ten minutes.

sections.title: The Sentinel Awakens
sections.intent: The final boss of the glitch zone engages Arlo, specifically designed to counter mobile players.
sections.end_condition: The Zone Sentinel initiates its 'anti-runner' pursuit protocol.

sections.title: The Infinite Retreat
sections.intent: A desperate chase where Arlo must use every mobility trick to survive the Sentinel's attacks.
sections.end_condition: Arlo keeps the Sentinel at bay as the patch timer reaches its final sixty seconds.

sections.title: The Final Seconds
sections.intent: Arlo reaches the altar and attempts to register his 'Bug' as a permanent feature.
sections.end_condition: Arlo activates the altar as the world fades to white for the maintenance update.

sections.title: The Log-In
sections.intent: Arlo wakes up in the post-patch world and checks his status for any 'fixes'.
sections.end_condition: Arlo confirms his stats are intact and he has been granted the 'Unfixable One' title.

sections.title: The New Reality
sections.intent: Arlo discovers that the patch has introduced 'Invulnerable' mobs that only he can damage.
sections.end_condition: Arlo kills a new 'Admin-Tier' mob that other players find impossible to touch.

sections.title: The Target on His Back
sections.intent: Establish the new status quo where Arlo is the game's most valuable and hunted player.
sections.end_condition: The major guilds surround Arlo, realizing he is the key to the new endgame content.
